legalFlow.q: Do I have my licences on me?
legalFlow.help: Photo ID, FWID (Fish and Wildlife ID) number, every species licence you hold this licence year (used and unused), federal bird permit for ducks and geese. 99% (synopsis pages 5, 7 and 8).
legalFlow.stop: No licence, no shot. Go get it.

legalFlow.q: Is it within legal hours right now?
legalFlow.help: Deer, quail and grouse: 1 hour before sunrise to 1 hour after sunset. Ducks and geese: 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes after sunset. 99% (synopsis page 12). Today's times: Legal light card.
legalFlow.stop: Too early or too late. Wait.

legalFlow.q: Is the season open for this species, sex and antler type in this MU (Management Unit) today?
legalFlow.help: Check the synopsis table for your exact MU, or the Rules tab. Antler rules count: a 4 point mule deer buck has at least 4 tines on one antler, not counting the brow tine. 99% (synopsis page 4).
legalFlow.stop: Not open for this animal here today. Let it walk.

legalFlow.q: Am I 100% sure what it is?
legalFlow.help: Species, sex, and antler points counted. For ducks: species identified before you shoot.
legalFlow.stop: Not sure means no. Watch it go and learn from it.

legalFlow.q: Am I off the road, out of the vehicle, and not shooting along or across a road?
legalFlow.help: Feet on the ground, away from the truck or ATV (all terrain vehicle). No shooting from a vehicle or motorboat. No shooting across, or hunting on, the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road: 15 m each side of the middle of a 2 lane road. 99% (synopsis pages 10 and 11).
legalFlow.stop: Get off the road and out of the vehicle first.

legalFlow.q: Am I more than 100 m from any occupied house, farm or ranch building?
legalFlow.help: BC rule, 99% (synopsis page 10). Includes your brother's house: the only owner exemption is for slaughtering livestock, not hunting (95%, my reading).
legalFlow.stop: Too close to a building. No shot.

legalFlow.q: Am I allowed to hunt on this land?
legalFlow.help: Crown land, or the owner's permission (the law on fenced, posted or cultivated land; get it in writing). Not a park closed to hunting, an ecological reserve or a No Shooting Area. 99% (synopsis pages 9, 10 and 12).
legalFlow.stop: No permission or closed area. No shot.

legalFlow.q: Is there a safe backstop and nothing behind it?
legalFlow.help: Earth behind the animal. No skyline shot. No people, roads, livestock or buildings beyond.
legalFlow.stop: No safe backstop. Bullets travel kilometres. No shot.

legalFlow.q: Is it a clean, ethical shot within my tested range?
legalFlow.help: Broadside or quartering away, still animal, steady rest, inside your practised distance.
legalFlow.stop: Wait for a better angle or get closer. A wounded animal is the worst outcome.

cards.title: Emergency
cards.html:
Emergency

  1. Call 911. If no signal, use a satellite messenger or iPhone Emergency SOS via satellite (if your model has it).
  2. Say where you are: GPS (Global Positioning System) coordinates from your map app, nearest road, landmark.
  3. Severe bleeding: firm direct pressure. Tourniquet high and tight on an arm or leg if pressure fails. Note the time.
  4. Stay together. Keep warm. Stay put once help is called.

Numbers

  • Emergency: 911
  • RAPP (Report All Poachers and Polluters): 1 877 952 7277, 24/7 99%
  • FrontCounter BC (licences): 1 877 855 3222 99%

Numbers: synopsis pages 2 and 5, checked 2026-10-02.

Write your brother's number and the land address here on paper too.

cards.title: Tag it
cards.html:
Right after the kill

  1. Confirm the animal is dead. Approach from behind, rifle ready.
  2. Cancel (notch) the species licence immediately, before you touch or move the animal. 99%
  3. Notch it the way the instructions printed on the licence say. A cancelled licence records the date, the region number and, where it applies, the antler configuration. 95%
  4. Keep evidence of sex naturally attached: the unskinned tail plus a testicle or part of the penis (buck), or part of the udder or teats (doe). 99% Antlers are not on the deer list, so keep these even on a buck. 95%
  5. 4 point season: antlers stay attached to part of the upper skull, kept with the licence. 99%
  6. Take photos: animal, licence, location.
  7. Deer need no compulsory inspection or compulsory report. 99%

Synopsis pages 11, 15 and 17; BC species licences page. Checked 2026-10-02. Full steps: Session 13.

cards.title: After the shot
cards.html:
After the shot

  1. Stay still. Watch where it runs. Listen.
  2. Mark the spot you shot from and where it stood (phone map pin).
  3. Wait at least 30 minutes before following (tip, opinion).
  4. Go to where it stood. Look for blood, hair, tracks.
  5. Follow the trail slowly. Mark the last blood each time.
  6. Lost the trail? Grid search from the last blood. Get help.
  7. The law: make all reasonable effort to find it, finish it and count it in your bag limit. 99%
  8. Trail crosses into fenced or posted private land: get the owner's permission first. No exception for wounded game. 99%

Synopsis page 12; BC hunting FAQ. Checked 2026-10-02. Full field dressing steps come in Session 13.
